primary_cta.subtext: Look around at your own pace, no enquiry needed
primary_cta.placement: At the existing <!-- CTA: primary --> marker, directly after the 'flying with your rings' paragraph in 'From the ring to the adventure: planning a wedding abroad'. Keep it there: it follows the practical evidence, which the sceptic and planner_couple both credited, and planner_couple said this destinations link is the one she would click first.

secondary_cta.subtext: The fee is agreed in writing before any work begins
secondary_cta.placement: Same paragraph as the primary CTA, second sentence (replaces the 'Talk to a Wedded Concierge about a wedding abroad' anchor). The fee line answers the sceptic's and funding_parent's main money worry using a brand-facts.md claim only.

lead_magnet.name: Wedded Wonderland digital magazine
lead_magnet.placement: Final line of the post, after the last FAQ answer, replacing the 'your Wedded Advisor starts with your date and your guest list' line the panel flagged as a second sales push. Gives the not-yet-ready reader (search_visitor, planner_couple) a low-commitment next step.

payload.rationale: Brief sets journey_stage dreaming with /destinations as the goal and Concierge secondary, matching the services.md early-stage rule. Panel weighted enquiry likelihood is 1.6: no persona would enquire from a ring article, but planner_couple (primary) would browse destinations first, so the destinations hub stays primary at the existing marker and the Concierge link is kept quiet and secondary. CTA reactions: funding_parent and sceptic held back over fees and deposits; the only brand-facts.md answer available is that the fee is agreed in writing before any work begins, so it becomes the secondary subtext. Deposits, AUD quotes, contracts, phone line and a named Advisor are deferred business items and are not stated. uhnw wants scale, security and a private line: none are in brand-facts.md, so nothing is added. search_visitor is pre-engagement, so the magazine (exists in the link map, services.md lists it as the early-stage lead magnet) closes the post instead of a second Advisor nudge. Suggested future magnet, not placed: a 'destination wedding planning starter' guide or checklist for early dreamers (does not exist on the site). 'Last updated' date to be set through the CMS date field at publish, not in body copy. All three targets confirmed in content-system/seo/link-map.csv (2026-10-20).
